name: bounded-parametric-design-iteration
intent: Improve an existing solved parametric design through isolated authorized changes and like-for-like post-change evidence while preserving attribution, rollback, and proof limits.
successCondition: Terminate with an exact iteration ledger showing an accepted evidence-backed improvement, a rollback or rejection, or a bounded stop reason.
inputs: exact solved baseline model setup and result evidence
editable parameters with units bounds and dependency scope
objective metrics hard constraints acceptance rule and iteration budget
mutation solver and local compute authority
outputs: per-iteration mutation preflight and approval record
accept rollback or stop receipt with residual uncertainty
operations: freeze exact baseline design setup results credibility and rollback point
select one bounded attributed parameter change
preflight geometry interfaces manufacturability mesh and solver readiness
gate mutation and solver effects on explicit authority
compare baseline and candidate like-for-like under hard constraints
accept rollback or terminate under the finite budget
positiveTriggers: improve an existing solved design against an explicit metric through bounded parameter edits
change one CAD parameter rerun the solver and compare exact baseline and candidate evidence
run a finite accept-or-rollback engineering design iteration
negativeTriggers: author a new CAD model from scratch
validate an unchanged numerical model without design mutation
optimize without an iteration budget or rollback
claim physical certification from CAD or simulation evidence
failureModes: baseline target parameter bounds or solver setup is incomplete
mutation or compute approval is missing or denied
candidate evidence is stale nonconverged lower credibility or not comparable
geometry interfaces mesh or hard constraints regress
iteration budget is exhausted without an acceptable candidate

conceptsUsed: finite recommend edit rerun compare loop
